Class StyleSetting

java.lang.Object
app.style.StyleSetting
public class StyleSetting extends Object
Provides styling configurations for the application. This class contains various CSS styles used for different UI components.

    • overlayStyle

      public String overlayStyle()
      Returns the CSS style for an overlay with a semi-transparent black background.
      Returns:
      A CSS string defining the background color with rgba transparency.

    • settingPaneStyle

      public String settingPaneStyle()
      Returns the CSS style for the settings pane. The style includes configurations for background color, border color, border style, border width, and border/background radius.
      Returns:
      A CSS string defining the visual style of the settings pane.

    • getLilitaOneFont

      public String getLilitaOneFont()
      Retrieves the file path for the Lilita One font.
      Returns:
      The file path of the "LilitaOne-Regular.ttf" font as a string in external form.

    • getCookieRunFont

      public String getCookieRunFont()
      Retrieves the file path for the Cookie Run font.
      Returns:
      The file path of the "CookieRun-Regular.ttf" font as a string in its external form.

    • settingTitleStyle

      public String settingTitleStyle()
      Returns the CSS style for the title in settings. The style includes configurations for text color and font weight.
      Returns:
      A CSS string defining the visual style of the title in the settings section.

    • setSliderStyle

      public String setSliderStyle()
      Returns the CSS style for configuring the appearance of a slider. The style includes transparency settings and a preferred height.
      Returns:
      A CSS string defining the visual style of a slider.

    • setThumbStyle

      public String setThumbStyle()
      Returns the CSS style for configuring the visual appearance of a thumb element. The style includes settings for background color, border color, border width, dimensions, and background radius.
      Returns:
      A CSS string defining the visual style of a thumb element.

    • setTrackStyle

      public String setTrackStyle()
      Returns the CSS style for configuring the visual appearance of a track element. The style includes background color, background radius, and preferred height.
      Returns:
      A CSS string defining the visual style of a track element.

    • enButtonCommonStyle

      public String enButtonCommonStyle()
      Returns the common CSS style for an English button. This style includes configurations for background color, text color, background insets, background radius, font size, font family, font weight, alignment, and text alignment.
      Returns:
      A CSS string defining the visual style of an English button.

    • krButtonCommonStyle

      public String krButtonCommonStyle()
      Returns the CSS style for configuring the appearance of a Korean language button. The style includes settings for background color, text color, background insets, background radius, alignment, and text alignment.
      Returns:
      A CSS string defining the visual style of the Korean language button.

    • enButtonPressedStyle

      Returns the CSS style for configuring the appearance of a pressed English button. The style includes settings for background color, text color, border color, border thickness, border radius, font size, font family, font weight, alignment, and text alignment.
